data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱4,748,000 – ₱5,698,000 (Varies by trim and model year)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 5,165 × 1,995 × 1,940 Wheelbase (mm): 3,075 Seating Capacity: 7–8 (depending on configuration)
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
5.6 L V8 Gasoline (VK56VD)
Maximum Output: ~400 hp Maximum Torque: ~560 Nm
Transmission: 7-speed Automatic with Manual Mode Drivetrain: 4WD with Hydraulic Body Motion Control on higher trims
Performance: Strong low-end torque with smooth V8 acceleration; tuned for heavy-duty capability rather than outright speed.
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Up to ~3,500 kg
Payload Capacity: Approx. 700–800 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 140 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 7–8
Infotainment: Large touchscreen display with smartphone connectivity Entertainment: Rear entertainment system available on higher trims Speakers: Premium multi-speaker sound system (varies by variant)
Interior Features: Leather seats, power adjustments, advanced climate control, luxury-focused layout
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Ventilated Disc
Suspension: Independent Double Wishbone (front and rear) Available Hydraulic Body Motion Control for stability and comfort
Tires / Wheels: 18” or 20” Alloy Wheels (variant-dependent)
Ground Clearance: Approx. 272 mm
